findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_manifest, get_exchange_answer, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Private data: find_matches, get_deal_flow, find_partner_services, publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Public sink: publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Destructive: publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_manifest, get_exchange_answer, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Private data: find_matches, get_deal_flow, find_partner_services, publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Public sink: publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement · Destructive: publish_manifest, reply_to_exchange, join_workspace, progress_candidate, withdraw_manifest, withdraw_engagement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
